authorization.rationale: Spring Security is imported in 39 files and JJWT in 8, with bucket4j rate limiting in 7 more, all concentrated in infrastructure/security.

state-machine.rationale: Few explicit state types: @Enumerated appears 4 times and the Status suffix once (ExportJobStatus for export jobs), so the concern is small.

integrations.rationale: Outgoing and file-exchange code shows up as the Renderer suffix (5) and java.util.zip (2), alongside the Adapter suffix (2) and java.net.http (1).

batch.rationale: Scheduled jobs and async execution are marked by org.springframework.scheduling (6 files) and @Scheduled (5), with the Scheduler suffix on 2 purge classes.
